methodology.scoring: frozen V1 trajectory score multiplied by normalized target-local IDF
methodology.development_case_used_for_error_analysis: T5 Copilot provider routing stress task

selector_microbenchmark_ms.notes: Local engineering sanity check using the recorded T5 36-candidate pool; not a task-quality benchmark.

known_limitations: The controlled fidelity benchmark is synthetic and demonstrates mechanism efficacy, not downstream coding-agent success.
T5 is a development/error-analysis case and must not be presented as held-out evidence.
Selector latency remains approximately linear in target size; the 8 MB sanity check was about 1.31 seconds.
Natural coding-agent trajectories previously reached the feature in 0 of 6 tasks because dedicated Grep outputs are intentionally lossless.
